title: DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731) now available as a Databricks-hosted model
body:
Model Serving now supports [DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731)](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#deepseek-v4-flash-0731) as a Databricks-hosted model in the `us-west-2` region. This hybrid mixture of experts (MoE) model has 284 billion total parameters and 13 billion active parameters and is optimized for fast, cost-efficient reasoning, coding, and agentic tool use. You can access this model using [Foundation Model APIs](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis).

Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with [applicable terms](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/acceptable-use-models).
